dataset.description: Directed graph, ring plus five distinct pseudorandom outgoing edges per node; 10% inactive nodes; no parallel edges or self loops.

children.details: p = (s)-[anon_0:LINK*..10]->(t) WHERE all(n IN nodes(p) WHERE n.status = $autostring_0)
sum(depth) AS anon_1, count(n) AS count
